environment.description: Same Lambda and Step Functions workflow deployed with identical code. S3 bucket serves dashboard HTML through CloudFront distribution with a custom Response Headers Policy (ID: 67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03) that appends security headers. The policy includes a Content-Security-Policy configuration with directive override enabled, setting: script-src 'self' https://cdn.monitoring.internal; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'. The CSP header is injected at the CloudFront edge with 'override: true' meaning even if the origin sets a CSP header, CloudFront replaces it. Additionally, the Lambda function's VPC security group (sg-0a4f8e2c1b3d5e7f9) has outbound rules restricted to port 443 on prefix list pl-02cd2c6b (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3) and the internal ALB CIDR 10.0.0.0/16, with an explicit deny on 169.254.0.0/16 via network ACL on the Lambda subnet. DNS resolution from the Lambda ENI goes through a Route 53 Resolver outbound endpoint with a forwarding rule that only resolves *.internal.company.com and *.amazonaws.com domains, dropping all other queries.
